授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
This lecture will focus on explanations given by the teacher, and will deepen relevant knowledge while also including exercises, small tests, and questions and answers.
This Lecture will be held face-to-face using Moodle courses. Student should register by accessing the following site. Lecture materials will also be posted on the Moodle course
https://moodle.s.kyushu-u.ac.jp/user/index.php?id=72163
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: Measurement is a procedure to quantify various kinds of physical quantities and then make clear the relationship and/or the mechanism of the phenomena to be understood. In recent years, the scope and importance of the measurement is expanding in broad aspects by the integration of information and communication technologies as can be seen as IoT especially. In this lecture, we will learn about  the fundamental principles of  measurement instruments in order to obtain reliable data, and methodologies for the measurements of various type of electromagnetic quantities.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: unit, signal, noise, measurement of electromagnetic quantities, measurement method, sensor
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件:
It is preferable to take courses of “Electromagnetism” and “Circuit theory” before taking this class.
Fundamental knowledge of electromagnetism and circuit theory is required.
